newsitem.title: USA: Texas Comptroller Sharp to run for Lt. Governor.
newsitem.headline: Texas Comptroller Sharp to run for Lt. Governor.

text.p: State Comptroller John Sharp has filed papers with the Texas Ethics Commission required to begin his campaign for lieutenant governor, a press release issued by his supporters said.
"John Sharp is a candidate for Lieutenant Governor and will make a public announcement very shortly," Sharp spokesman Ross Ramsey said in a release issued Saturday by Texans for John Sharp.
Sharp said he decided to run after Bob Bullock, the current lieutenant governor and Sharp's predecessor in the comptroller's office, announced he would not seek re-election next year.
